messages:
Priya: quick preflight for cloud storefront — prod-ish checklist so we don’t hit packaging surprises next month. 20min sync follow-up after this thread.

Dan: can we keep this lean? top needs: SKU ids + meter types, canonical artifact (single AMI or container), trial behavior, and billing CSV schema. who is the artifact owner?

Miguel: EngOps takes artifact production (AMI + OCI image). will wire a nightly pipeline that tags regional artifacts. need partner account IDs + permitted regions.

Priya: assigned: Miguel -> artifact pipeline & staging registry; Dan -> SKU mapping & billing schema; Leah -> legal/compliance sign-off; Tom -> marketing assets + copy.

Leah: legal checklist: base EULA, DPA, and SOC attestation doc. also need clarity on telemetry during trial (prefer opt-in). timeline: 5-7 business days for baseline EULA variants, add 2-3 days per localization.

Tom: marketing asks: 1 short elevator sentence, 3 bullets, and a hero screenshot (16:9 1280x720). need staging UI link for screenshots by next Tue.

Miguel: staging URL (internal): https://staging.redwood.internal/marketplace. will create a read-only service account for screenshots and publish nightly builds there.

Dan: marketplace approach: publish two sku types per offer — consumption-metered and flat-subscription. trial model: 14-day entitlement with no charge; ingestion should return zero usage during trial window.

Priya: Partnerships: please populate a CSV with columns: cloud, offer_label, sku_label, sku_id_placeholder, meter_type, trial_allowed, publisher_account_id, region_list, partner_contact. I'll use it to inject SKU ids once they exist.

Miguel: security note: add audit events for onboarding flows. EngOps will stream provisioning/audit logs to the tenant audit bucket and central marketplace bucket.

Leah: product blurb must surface residency options. suggest a short line: "Select data region at provisioning — contact Sales for dedicated residency."

Tom: will draft copy by Friday. need staging access Monday to grab screenshots of the provisioning flow.

Priya: Terraform: we need a publisher example in terraform/publisher with placeholders for offer_id and trial_sku and sample .tfvars. Miguel can you add?

Miguel: yes. I'll add example snippet to README and a sample tfvars. snippet will look like:

```
module "redwood_publisher" {
  source    = "github.com/redwood/integrations/terraform//publisher"
  offer_id  = "OFFER_PLACEHOLDER"
  trial_sku = "TRIAL_PLACEHOLDER"
  regions   = ["us-west-2", "eu-west-1"]
}
```

Dan: billing ingestion CSV spec: header = timestamp,sku_id,customer_id,units,region. provide a sample generator script so partners can QA.

Priya: timeline: artifacts + README + SKU sheet + marketing draft + baseline EULA to legal by next Tue to keep our soft-launch window.

Miguel: I'll open a PR today for pipeline + README; ETA artifacts pushed to staging by EOD Tue.

Leah: once I get baseline EULA text, I'll turn around EU/UK variants in ~7 business days. translations are extra.

Priya: regional gate: minimum US + EU for soft launch; APAC desirable but can be phased. EngOps—can APAC builds run concurrently?

Miguel: yes, parallel runners available. will annotate pipeline jobs per region and tag AMIs/images accordingly.

Tom: will also prepare a short FAQ snippet on trial telemetry (opt-in default) and data residency to include in storefront notes.

Priya: final items before our 20min checklist sync: 1) spreadsheet link with placeholders, 2) terraform example PR, 3) staging screenshot access, 4) baseline EULA draft to Leah.

Dan: noted. will draft the SKU mapping template and sample billing CSV.

Leah: ping me directly if any compliance questionnaires hit before the sync.

Miguel: PR up in ~2 hours. will link artifacts in the spreadsheet when ready.

Priya: can everyone hit those ETAs? drop emoji or ETA if not.

Dan: :thumbsup:
Leah: :thumbsup:
Miguel: :thumbsup:
Tom: :thumbsup:
Priya: :rocket:

OnboardingBot: Reminder set — 20min checklist review added to #partnerships calendar.
